description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Pride], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode (Wind, Holy)] and [Dreams and Dignity] to the user, grants [PHY +30% Boost (15s)] to the user if Cloud or Zack are alive

description.name: Awoken Pride
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Holy] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Dreams and Dignity
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Wind or Holy ability

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack
